title: fix(components,plugin-grid,types): a masked grid cell hands its raw value to nobody
body:
Fixes #10583
Clause-②: yes — `TableColumn` (published `@object-ui/types`) gains a declared key, and the data table's Ctrl+C refuses a masked cell.

## What changed

The house shape is the detail page's (objectui#8440, option A: no copy at all, never the bullets), with `isMaskedFieldType()` (objectui#8686) as the one authority. `components` cannot import `@object-ui/fields`, so the rule is not restated in the table: the producer asks, and the table obeys a flag.

- **`@object-ui/types`**: new declared key `TableColumn.masked?: boolean` (its JSDoc names objectui#10583 and `isMaskedFieldType()` as the producer-side authority). It is mirrored as `z.boolean()` on `TableColumnSchema`, like `fitContent` / `wrap`, and tombstoned on `StaticTableColumn` / `StaticTableColumnSchema` under the lockstep rule. `static-table-narrow-surface.test.ts` gains the key in its exhaustive lists.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-grid`**: a new helper `isMaskedGridColumn(columnType, objectFieldType)` in `src/maskedColumn.ts`. It is the narrow-only UNION, in the same shape as `isMaskedDetailFieldType`. `ObjectGrid` calls it once, at the emit seam that every column already passes through (the four `generateColumns()` literals and the enrichment map). It runs BEFORE the `normalizeTableColumnType` fold, because the fold drops `password` / `secret` (they are not `TableColumnType` members). The flag is written only when true, so an unmasked column is unchanged.
- **`@object-ui/components`** `data-table.tsx`, where the table obeys `col.masked`:
  1. `handleCellKeyDown`: Ctrl+C / Cmd+C writes nothing, and `preventDefault()` stays.
  2. The cell wrapper draws no `title` tooltip. That tooltip carried the RAW value: see "Premise" below.
  3. `handleExport` (the built-in CSV) leaves masked columns out.
- **Docs**: `content/docs/components/complex/data-table.mdx` adds `masked` to the `TableColumn` block and a "Masked columns" section. `packages/plugin-grid/README.md` gains one paragraph under "Cell appearance". The docs frontmatter is byte-identical: the md5 of lines 1-4 is `d069943e…` before and after.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/10583-masked-cell-copy.md`: `'@object-ui/types': minor`, `'@object-ui/components': patch`, `'@object-ui/plugin-grid': patch`.

## Decisions, and what they rest on

- **Write nothing, and keep `preventDefault()`. Do not let the browser copy.** I measured this in Chromium (the preinstalled `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`). The page was a focused `td` holding `••••••`, and the clipboard was seeded with `SENTINEL`. Focus with no selection: both options leave `SENTINEL`. With the mask selected, `preventDefault` leaves `SENTINEL`, but the browser default puts the bullets on the clipboard. objectui#8440's ruling refused that payload ("copying the bullets … a second silent wrong answer").
- **CSV export: the column is left out, not blanked.** A column of empty strings would claim the records hold nothing, and re-importing it would write that.
- **One stamp site, not four.** Measured: every path that writes `type` reaches the emit-seam `.map`. The pins cover the three emit shapes: configured `ListColumn[]`, a string array, and the object-schema default.
- **The flag withholds; it does not draw.** A JSON-authored `data-table` column with `masked: true` and no `cell` still draws its value. This is stated in the JSDoc, the zod `.describe()` and the docs. It is raised as an open question in the report.

## Premise (checked against `origin/main` `c2d86599b`)

- Reproduced on base: `ObjectGrid` with a `password` field. Ctrl+C on the masked `td` wrote `RAW-PASSWORD-10583`. The `text` control copied `Row one`.
- **The card's `rawInDom: false` was a reading of the text only.** The data-table cell wrapper carried `title={String(cellValue)}` on every non-fit cell, so the raw credential was in the DOM and showed on hover. Leg A3 below shows `document.body.innerHTML` containing `RAW-PASSWORD-10583` with only that gate removed. This is fixed here in place under the bounded same-class exemption. It is the same defect class (a masked cell hands out its raw value), in the same file and the same claim, with the same gate family.

## Evidence: red on base, green on head

New pins: `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/maskedCellCopyRefusal-10583.test.tsx` (6 tests) and `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/__tests__/data-table-masked-column-10583.test.tsx` (7 tests). Each absence carries a control in the same mounted tree, counted at the spy.

| run | result |
|---|---|
| leg 0: the 4 implementation files at base `c2d86599b`, new pins kept | **11 failed / 2 passed (13)**. The 2 that pass are the flag-ABSENT controls. |
| head `6bad2d4ff` | **13 passed (13)** |

Per-hunk ablations, each done with `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 → 0, blob changed). After each one, `git diff HEAD` was empty.

| leg | mutation | red (of 13) | which |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | table refusal line removed | 8 | both data-table copy pins and all 6 grid pins |
| A2 | producer stamp `? { ...draft, masked: true }` → `? draft` | 6 | all 6 grid pins; data-table pins stay green |
| A3 | `!col.masked &&` removed from `title` | 7 | data-table tooltip pin + 6 grid pins ("raw value is nowhere in the DOM") |
| A4 | export filter removed | 1 | the CSV pin (`Name,Key`) |
| A5 | union narrowed to the column type alone | 2 | the configured-shape pins at "Vault Key (text over secret)" |

The lint row is a narrowing, not the repo-wide `pnpm lint`, which CI owns. It covers exactly the changed files. `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and the diff cannot move a verdict in an untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- **Two other producers of data-table columns are the same class, and neither is touched here.** `RelatedList.normalizeColumn` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`) and `ObjectDataTable.normalizeColumns` (`@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`) draw a `password` cell as the mask through `getCellRenderer`. They never set `masked`. I measured this with a throwaway probe on head `bcec471b8`: both drew `••••••`, the raw value was in `innerHTML` but not in the text, and Ctrl+C on the masked `td` wrote `RAW-PROBE-10583`. Reported to the seat as one finding for the family.
- **`ObjectGrid`'s own export menu** (`exportOptions`) was read only, not measured. When the data source has no `exportDownload`, it falls back to a client CSV that writes `record[field]` for every `generateColumns()` field, plus a whole-record JSON. It does not read the flag. Reported as a finding. The server-streamed path is masked server-side.
- **Recorded, not filed.** Both are read only, not measured. The data table's client search and sort still run over raw values, so a masked column can act as a search or ordering oracle. A view that authors `type: 'text'` over a `secret` field keeps the refusal but draws the value in the clear: that is the display the author chose, and it is unchanged here.
- `useCellClipboard` (plugin-grid, zero in-repo callers) copies raw values. It is already recorded in objectui#10568's notes.
- Overlap: the `pm:blocked` draft objectui#10278 edits `ObjectGrid.tsx` in its page-size hunk. This PR touches only the emit-seam `.map` and one import line. `git merge-tree` against `origin/main` `eca276070` was clean, and main has not moved in any file this PR touches.
- Pending changesets: `git grep -l -i "clipboard\|ctrl+c" origin/main -- .changeset` finds `8440`, `8686`, `8395`, `8596` and `6278`. No sentence in them is falsified by this change. `check-changeset-claims` flagged 29 pending bodies that name a touched file. I read them, and none states a key count, a copy path or an export path that this change moves.
